summary: Honor claim idempotency keys in the smallclaims ViewRuntime reference runtime

replay.detail: No replay or backfill. Claims previously written without operation metadata remain unchanged.

schema.detail: Uses the existing operations table and claim operation metadata; no schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: ViewRuntime now returns the original claim for a repeated keyed request, rejects a changed request with idempotency-mismatch, and validates keys using the shared claim-operation helper. Keyless writes retain their existing behavior. Old builds still ignore these keys; use the fixed runtime for keyed writes.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption or recovery work is introduced.

manual.detail: No migration or configuration steps. Existing duplicates are not removed and old claims without operation metadata do not acquire idempotency keys.

recovery.detail: New operation metadata uses the existing storage format. Reverting to an older ViewRuntime restores its behavior of ignoring idempotency keys and can append duplicates; retain the fixed runtime when relying on keyed writes.
